author: Bethesda Softworks

The gates of Oblivion are opening on Nintendo Switch ™ 2. 

The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered launches on August 11, bringing Bethesda Game Studios’ classic open-world RPG to Nintendo players with stunning new visuals, refined gameplay and the complete story experience.
